description: Python fragment. There is no separate `uv` manager — Renovate's pep621 manager handles
pyproject.toml plus uv, pdm, hatch and pixi, and it maintains uv.lock and pdm.lock through
lockFileMaintenance by shelling out to the real CLI. anomalog and the two yodidac tool
packages are uv projects; casahouse has one loose requirements.txt under business-tools.

packageRules.description: One PR per repo for every non-major Python change, across pyproject.toml and requirements.txt alike.
requires-python declares the supported interpreter range — moving it is a support-policy change, not a dependency bump.
Test and lint tooling is chore(deps).
